identificationModule.briefTitle: Assessing Treatment of T-Cell Lymphoma With GW5282 in Combination With Golidocitinib (BEI-DOU3)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase I/II Clinical Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of GW5282 in Combination With Golidocitinib in the Treatment of T-Cell Lymphoma

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a phase 1/2 open-label study to evaluate GW5282 in combination with golidocitinib (G2 regimen) for the treatment of T-cell lymphoma. In the first phase of the study, the maximum tolerated dose will be determined through dose escalation; in the second phase, the potential therapeutic advantages of the novel combination therapy over the conventional CHOP regimen will be preliminarily assessed through a randomized controlled design.

interventions.name: GW5282 combined with Golidocitinib
interventions.description: GW5282 and Golidocitinib will be administered in combination as twice daily (BID) and once daily (QD), respectively. The starting dose will be GW5282 40 mg BID combined with golidocitinib 150 mg QD. If tolerated, the dose of GW5282 will be subsequently escalated.

interventions.name: GW5282 combined with Golidocitinib
interventions.description: GW5282 and Golidocitinib will be administered at the doses determined during escalation part.

interventions.name: Conventional CHOP regimen
interventions.description: CHOP regimen includes the administrations of Cyclophosphamide, Doxorubicin, Vincristine, and Prednisone.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Part A: Incidence of Treatment-Emergent Adverse Events [Safety and Tolerability]).
primaryOutcomes.description: To evaluate the safety and tolerability of the combination of GW5282 and golidocitinib. Dose Limiting Toxicity (DLT) was evaluated in the DLT observation frame.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: The DLT observation period is defined as the 21 days after the first dose.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Part B: Complete Response Rate (CRR) According to Lugano 2014 by Investigators' Review
primaryOutcomes.description: To evaluate anti-tumor activity of GW5282 combined with golidocitinib as a chemo-free induction therapy for newly diagnosed PTCL, and compare it with conventional CHOP regimen.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 6 cycles, each cycle is 21 days
